commit_message: Implement ADR 0125 Project Rust VFX gameplay control
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 VFX first-release scope
pr_body: Completes the remaining ADR 0125 first-release VFX architecture after a current-main re-audit. This first request adds the formal Project Rust deferred VFX command/view boundary; follow-up requests on the same task branch complete schema-driven authoring, shared production preview, Problems integration, and performance/visual validation evidence.
